scopeNotes: The provider-organization-documents failure was a narrow verification-repair scope exception. The runtime correctly performs account, organization, and documents loading; the test previously asserted an incidental third-call count while the documents surface was still in its loading mount. The assertion now waits for the ready state and verifies the rendered documents content. frontend_024 was not reopened because no runtime contract or behavior defect was found.
The Admin Ads review-feedback persistence change is within frontend_070 runtime scope and keeps refetch/invalidation behavior while preserving the visible success state.
Approved Admin Dashboard scope is Desktop-only; Arabic is RTL and English/Simplified Chinese are LTR. No Production data, secrets, or permanent private-file URLs were used.
